chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Nawfalī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his father, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from his father, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Nawfalī.

key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ: A transmitter named within the sanad/isnad of this report.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the named transmitter.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating the author’s mode of hadith transmission.
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّوْفَلِيِّ: A narrator to whom the transmission chain in this passage leads.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Nawfalī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Nawfalī. It is a technical chain statement used to document transmission authority in hadith literature rather than a substantive doctrinal or legal matn.
